topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and previews the key themes of cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the cell-intrinsic molecular alterations that confer growth advantages and drive the evolutionary progression of incipient tumors.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchies in tumor initiation
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate how a cell's position within normal tissue differentiation hierarchies influences its susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how inflammatory signals, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal cells create permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth and maintenance.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying cancer biology
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the laboratory models, sequencing technologies, and spatial omics methods used to investigate clonal dynamics and microenvironments.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational accumulation, cell-of-origin properties, and permissive microenvironments interact to drive malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next steps
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
